method_limits: the population is E506's published face; a pair appears here because that face classed the name as outside the witness vocabulary, not because this study re-read E506's rows
a vintage is only evidence if the field is readable in it; a commit whose blob is not local to this promisor clone is counted as unread, never as unchanged

the writing arm reads dict literals and subscript assignments in scripts/ and Tools/ only; a face written by a YAML/JSON template, by a pandas to_json, or by code outside those two directories shows no writing site
a literal writing site is treated as proof of a constant even where vintages exist: one literal in the producer outweighs a value that happened to be equal in two siblings

the date anchor is the newest date anywhere else in the same payload; a face that knows its data only under a non-date-shaped string (a bar number, an epoch int) has no anchor and its field is classed undecided rather than guessed
archival copies under results/_quarantine/ and results/_r*_rollback_side/ are read as vintages of the live face and are published as such beside the live one
population_source: results/state_tilt/NODATEWITNESS-2026-11-07.json rows whose witness_class is a structured date under a name outside the witness list
title: For every face E506 classed as carrying a structured date under a name outside the witness list: does that field move when the face is rebuilt, and is it a freshness witness at all?
